task.title: Confirming client/server relationships
task.shortdesc: At any given time the Supervisor station may be the client of a controller station and vice versa. This procedure confirms that a client for the Supervisor station exists in the controller station and a client for the controller station exists in the Supervisor station.

step.cmd: Expand the Drivers NiagaraNetwork node in the Supervisor Nav tree. It should contain a node for each controller.
Expand the Drivers NiagaraNetwork in a controller Nav tree. It should contain a node for the Supervisor station.
If either node does not exist, discover the station.
